title: Desktop files
whyItMatters: Whatever was left on the desktop: documents, photos, screenshots, exports and shortcuts. File names alone often reveal health, money, family and work details.
source: Windows known folder Desktop, default path under the user profile: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/redirect-known-folders
notes: If OneDrive Known Folder Move is on, the real Desktop is %USERPROFILE% OneDrive Desktop and this folder may be empty or a stub; both are counted separately. The Desktop folder of every user on the PC is the user-profiles rules' job.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy what you want to keep to an external drive or your cloud account before deleting anything in this folder.
steps: Open the folder named in the plan and look through it before deleting anything.
Check for the same files in OneDrive if the folder looks empty, because Known Folder Move can redirect it.
Copy what you keep to a drive you are taking with you, then delete the rest.
cleanup.risk: Anything deleted from the desktop is gone unless you copied it out first. Shortcuts can be recreated; files cannot.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Free up drive space in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/storage-filemanagement/free-up-drive-space-in-windows
